_source: Published tool surface of cloudflare/mcp @ 66b361ed7c94153bb37a5d0c94874c860a86cb0c (src/tools/*.ts). Long dynamic descriptions shortened. Replace by running `python3 codemode/gen_wrappers.py cloudflare_api` with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN set.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Cloudflare API Spec Search
tools.description: Search the Cloudflare OpenAPI spec by running a JavaScript async arrow function against `spec` (all $refs pre-resolved inline); returns only the operations, parameters or schemas the code selects.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to search the OpenAPI spec

truncate.description: Cap the result at ~6,000 tokens. Set to false only when the result goes straight to a file or pipe, not into the conversation.

tools.name: execute
tools.title: Cloudflare API Execute
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code against the Cloudflare API with cloudflare.request({ method, path, query, body }); chain calls, paginate and reduce results inside the code.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to execute

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID to run against. Optional when the session is authorized for exactly one account.

truncate.description: Cap the result at ~6,000 tokens. Set to false only when the result goes straight to a file or pipe, not into the conversation.

tools.name: docs
tools.title: Cloudflare Docs Search
tools.description: Search the Cloudflare developer documentation (Workers, Durable Objects, D1, KV, R2, Access, DNS and more); returns semantically similar chunks.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Current Cloudflare Identity
tools.description: Return the Cloudflare user or account this connection is authenticated as ({ id, email } or { id, name }); takes no arguments.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.title: Send Feedback to Cloudflare
tools.description: Report a problem with Cloudflare products, this MCP server or its tools to the Cloudflare team.
